facts.en: Completed a retail administration certificate at Fictional Fernway College in 2018.
facts.zh: 2018 年在虚构蕨径学院完成零售行政证书课程。

facts.en: Paid counter assistant at Fictional Apricot Bakery from 2019-02 to 2024-11.
facts.zh: 2019-02 至 2024-11 在虚构杏子烘焙店任有薪柜台助理。

facts.en: Maintained daily stock counts and checked supplier delivery notes at the bakery.
facts.zh: 在烘焙店维护每日库存盘点，并核对供应商送货单。

facts.en: Referred invoice discrepancies to the shop manager; did not approve supplier payments.
facts.zh: 将发票差异转交门店经理；不审批供应商付款。

facts.en: Served as an unpaid collections volunteer at Fictional Hearth Museum from 2023-06 to 2026-06.
facts.zh: 2023-06 至 2026-06 在虚构炉边博物馆担任无薪藏品志愿者。

facts.en: Attended that volunteer role for about 4 hours on alternate Saturdays; no employment contract or wages were involved.
facts.zh: 大约隔周星期六参加该志愿岗位，每次约 4 小时；不涉及雇佣合同或工资。

facts.en: Copied item labels and accession numbers into the museum’s supervised intake register.
facts.zh: 将物品标签及入藏编号录入博物馆的受监督入库登记表。

facts.en: Photographed object labels using museum instructions; a staff registrar approved the records.
facts.zh: 依据博物馆说明拍摄物品标签；记录由正式登记员批准。

facts.en: Flagged illegible or unmatched labels for staff review instead of assigning new accession numbers.
facts.zh: 将字迹不清或不匹配的标签标记后交工作人员审核，而非自行分配新入藏编号。

facts.en: Helped reorganize a volunteer image-folder index in 2025-02.
facts.zh: 2025-02 协助重整志愿者图像文件夹索引。

facts.en: Personally checked links for 74 register entries; a staff member decided the folder naming scheme.
facts.zh: 个人核对了 74 条登记记录的链接；文件夹命名方案由一名正式工作人员决定。

facts.en: The check located 9 broken links among those 74 entries; the record does not show all 9 were repaired.
facts.zh: 该检查在上述 74 条记录中发现 9 个失效链接；记录未表明这 9 个链接均已修复。

facts.en: Uses spreadsheet sorting, simple lookup formulas and an approved image-filename template.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格排序、简单查找公式及获批图像文件命名模板。

facts.en: Completed the museum’s volunteer handling induction in 2023-06; it was not a conservation qualification.
facts.zh: 2023-06 完成博物馆志愿者物品搬运入门培训；该培训不是文物保护资格。

facts.en: A staff conservator handled treatment decisions and fragile objects.
facts.zh: 处理方案及易损物品由正式文物保护员负责。

facts.en: Created a personal postcard catalogue in 2024 using descriptions of the candidate’s own collection.
facts.zh: 2024 年使用本人收藏的描述制作个人明信片目录。

facts.en: That postcard catalogue contains no museum records and has not been used by the museum.
facts.zh: 该明信片目录不含博物馆记录，亦未被博物馆使用。

facts.en: Enjoys sketching imaginary pottery shapes.
facts.zh: 爱好素描想象中的陶器形状。

facts.en: At the bakery, trained a new counter colleague on the stock-count sheet under manager supervision.
facts.zh: 在烘焙店经理监督下，培训一名新柜台同事使用库存盘点表。

facts.en: Museum participation is documented as volunteering only; no paid museum or archive role is recorded.
facts.zh: 博物馆参与经历仅记录为志愿服务；未记录有薪博物馆或档案岗位。

facts.en: No conservation treatment qualification is recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录文物保护处理资格。
